core_obligations: The authors prove local Birman-Schwinger compactness for atomless charge distributions, separate finitely many strong atoms from the diffuse and far-field pieces, and obtain a strict large-imaginary-parameter resolvent bound. This constructs the unique distinguished extension, norm-resolvent truncation limit, domain regularity away from strong atoms and the stated essential spectrum without a bound on total charge.
